create_stretch_client: create a StretchClient instance to control a Stretch robot via the remote hardware interface
acquire_camera_images: get camera images from the robot head using robot.head.get_images()
move_camera_pan_tilt: move the robot camera to a specific pan and tilt angle using robot.head.set_pan_tilt()
navigate_robot_base: command the robot base to navigate to a target xyt waypoint using robot.nav.navigate_to()
control_arm_ee_pose: command the robot arm end-effector to an absolute or relative pose using robot.manip.goto_ee_pose()
